abstract: Long-form temporal audio grounding (TAG) is challenging because target events often occupy only a small portion of a recording, while queries may impose multiple semantic constraints over a large temporal search space. We propose a query-conditioned liquid temporal grounding framework that injects query semantics through FiLM before a closed-form continuous-time (CfC) network models long-range temporal dependencies. Multiple query-relevant candidates are generated, from which a frozen large audio-language model selects the most compatible one for lightweight local boundary refinement. The pretrained backbone remains frozen, with only lightweight grounding modules optimized. Experiments on the English TAG subset of LAT-Bench show consistent improvements across MOSS-Audio and Qwen3-Omni, while ablations confirm the complementary roles of FiLM and CfC.

oneSentenceThesis: 针对长录音中目标很短且查询约束多的问题，该文用查询调制加连续时间时序建模先产生多个候选，再由冻结大音频语言模型选优并做局部边界修正，在 LAT-Bench 英文子集上提升定位精度但严格阈值下仍有选择瓶颈。
originalTitle: Query-Conditioned Liquid Temporal Grounding for Long-Form Audio
